scope: Read existing frozen results only; no simulation or parameter changes. This is the only file written by this reviewer.

bootstrap.independent_recalculation: NumPy only, no project evaluation/statistics imports
bootstrap.unit: source with all eight paired suffixes retained
bootstrap.strata: five tasks, three sources resampled per task
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5%/97.5%; nominal and not corrected for seven comparisons

conclusions: The main negative result is no approximate +5 percentage point improvement over replan: velocity -1.666667 pp, direct +0.833333 pp, post 0 pp. Direct adds only one net success and is not an established stable winner.

Every correction-versus-a0 paired outcome change is concentrated in two stick-pull sources. Direct has one net-positive source and 14 net-zero sources, but net zero is not identical paired outcomes: its total 3 rescues coexist with 2 harms.

Replan improves over continue_old by +29.166667 pp (38 rescues, 3 harms), but this is a full policy contrast that jointly changes interruption, 50-to-10 cadence, and initial command postprocessing. It is not the incremental correction benefit.

All three correction objectives increase predicted success by about 10–11 pp on average, while true incremental gains are near zero or negative. This batch does not reproduce the prior development post gain. It does not by itself isolate scoring error from flow integration because reverse/random are generated but not rolled out here.

Guidance was active: no fallback, 90 finite nonzero updates, positive XYZ command changes on every source, and matched actual command radii verified. Near-zero gain cannot be labeled an implementation no-op from these data.
limitations: Only 15 independent sources and three per task. Narrow empirical bootstrap intervals for correction differences arise from nearly all observed source differences being zero; do not interpret them as a guarantee against unobserved rare-source gains or harms.
Nominal intervals touch zero for the small direct advantage; seven registered comparisons have no multiplicity adjustment. Do not select a definitive winner from +0.833333 pp.
Eight sources have a0 8/8, five have a0 0/8, and two have 1/8. Success-count gains are highly concentrated; task aggregates cannot establish broad reliability.
Corrector matched post still requires the complete shared candidate bank, including generated reverse/random and flow directions; gradient-only time is not full deployment cost.

No reverse/random physical outcomes or new native-strength correction arms were collected in this five-arm batch; local directional superiority and native-versus-matched mechanism differences cannot be independently estimated here.
This small fresh-source batch is not the separate preregistered 100-source confirmation experiment. No extra simulation is authorized by this review.
